claim: The analysis by Walhi Jambi recorded 65,429 hectares of forest and land fires in Jambi.
note: The source explicitly states: 'luas kebakaran di jambi menjadi 65.429 hektar'.

claim: The estimated health cost related to ISPA (respiratory issues) from fires is between 19.2 trillion and 224.65 trillion rupiah.
note: Confirmed by the source: 'Biaya kesehatan terkait ispa rp19,20 triliun-rp224,65 triliun'.

claim: For a force of 500 N and an area of 2 m², the pressure is 250 Pa.
Pressure is force exerted on a given surface area, with the formula p = F ÷ A.
note: Standard physical definition for pressure matches the source content.

claim: The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa).
